d:
Listen and sing along this classic superhit Hindi song, "Chocolate Lime Juice" sung by Lata Mangeshkar from the Hindi movie " Hum Apke Hai Koun " staring Salman Khan, and Madhuri Dixit in lead roles.
Song: Chocolate Lime Juice
Movie: Hum Aapke Hain Koun (1994)
Singer: Lata Mangeshkar
Music: Raamlaxman
Lyrics: Dev Kohli
Cast: Salman Khan, Madhuri Dixit
Director: Sooraj R. Barjatya
